dev.command: TOKEN=$(tsx tools/orchestration/generate-auth-token.ts) && rm -f /tmp/router-flux2.log && (SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN=$TOKEN tsx apps/router/src/serve.ts > /tmp/router-flux2.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/router-flux2.pid) && while ! grep -q 'listening on' /tmp/router-flux2.log 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.1; done && URL=$(grep -o 'http://[^ ]*' /tmp/router-flux2.log | head -n 1) && tsx tools/orchestration/upsert-artifact.ts router dev router-flux2 APP_URL=$URL SECRET_AUTH_TOKEN=$TOKEN && wait $(cat /tmp/router-flux2.pid)
